hypothesis: Matched low-e arm of the seed 70-72 eccentricity sweep. From e<=0.5 to e<=0.6, the accel_step margin increase comes from the random control falling, not from better decoding. At e in [0, 0.5] (N=64, 4 layers, d_model=64, m2 in [0.1, 1], seeds 70-72), raw layer-4 accel_step R2 matches the seed-matched e<=0.6 values (0.868-0.871), while the best-of-5 control R2 is higher (>= 0.70 vs 0.667-0.682).
expected_if_true: In at least 2 of 3 seeds, final best-layer accel_step R2 is within 0.03 of the same seed's e<=0.6 value (seed 70: 0.870, seed 71: 0.868, seed 72: 0.871), and the accel_step control R2 is >= 0.70, so the final margin is <= 0.18. Formation steps are read from the per-checkpoint trajectory with a strict >= 0.1 bar on unrounded margins, but they are descriptive only and not part of the pass condition.
expected_if_false: In at least 2 of 3 seeds, raw accel_step R2 differs from the same seed's e<=0.6 value by >= 0.04, or the control R2 is < 0.69, which would mean the e<=0.5 -> 0.6 margin change is not explained by the control alone. Any other pattern, or a run below 80% completion, counts as inconclusive.
